title: Dodecahedral Dual Topology
negative_results: require_dodeca_vertex refuses an IcosaFaceId (face is not a vertex)
dual_vertex_of_face refuses a bare int and refuses a DodecaVertexId

claims.statement: The 20-vertex dodecahedral dual is a distinct graph (12 pentagon faces, 20 vertices, 30 edges) with correct dual incidence (icosa faces<->dodeca vertices, icosa vertices<->dodeca faces, edges preserved) and V-E+F=2.
Icosa face ids and dodeca vertex ids are distinct types; treating a face id as a vertex id without the dual map is a typed refusal (ConflationError).
Neither a vertex id nor a face id denotes a place. SOURCE_VECTOR_GEOGRAPHIC_SEMANTICS_NOT_CLAIMED; PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.
